subject: Re: Azureno Bridge co-sell — reassignment & consolidated runbook
messages:
From: Nico Sanchez <nico.sanchez@azureno-bridge.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azureno x Redwood co-sell run of show — SI lead reassignment

Connor/Vanessa/Marissa,

Quick note — our AWS SE (Luis) just had a client conflict and cannot lead the AWS portion for the co-sell demo on Tue 18th. We still want to keep the joint session but need to reassign the SI lead.

Proposed options (all PST):
- Option A: Tue 2027-05-18 10:00–11:00 PST (preferred)
- Option B: Tue 2027-05-18 13:00–14:00 PST
- Option C: Wed 2027-05-19 09:00–10:00 PST

We can provide a short replacement brief (15m) for the new SI lead. Also, can you confirm who will own the GCP marketplace breakout and whether Redwood can provide an updated consolidated runbook and slide deck? Attaching the current runbook for reference (Azureno_CoSell_Runbook_v2.pdf).

Attendees from our side: Nico Sanchez (SI lead), Amelia Ford (sales), and the AWS partner rep TBD.

Thanks — Nico

Attachments: Azureno_CoSell_Runbook_v2.pdf (doc stub)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Nico Sanchez <nico.sanchez@azureno-bridge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azureno x Redwood co-sell run of show — SI lead reassignment

Nico — thanks for the heads up. Short answers below and a proposed fallback plan.

We can cover AWS if Vanessa is available to step in as the presenter; Vanessa, can you confirm? If not, we can push to Option B.

Rishi — can you lead the GCP marketplace breakout? It will be a 12–15 minute technical demo focusing on the listing flow and inference latency comparisons.

Fallback plan (if Luis replacement not available):
- Redwood presents AWS portion (Vanessa covers product + ops)
- Azureno covers customer/business context and handoff to GCP breakout

Timezone note: we have an APAC PM (Amelia) who may only join the tail end; if we move earlier to Option A she might miss it. If APAC attendance is required, Option B is safer.

My availability (PST): I can do A or B but prefer A to avoid end-of-day overlap for EU participants. Please confirm by EOD and we'll push a calendar update + consolidated runbook.

Subject: Re: Azureno x Redwood co-sell run of show — SI lead reassignment

Connor/Nico — I can cover the AWS portion and present the run-of-show for Option A (10:00–11:00 PST). I do have a conflict Tues afternoon, so Option B is harder for me.

Vanessa notes:
- I will take the AWS live demo (10–25m), product positioning (5m), and handoff to GCP breakout.
- Need the consolidated slide deck by 6pm PST today so I can run a quick dry run tomorrow morning.

Rishi — if you can confirm GCP breakout ownership, I will add you as the technical lead in the runbook.

Cc: Nico Sanchez <nico.sanchez@azureno-bridge.com>, Amelia Ford <amelia.ford@helixsys.com>, gcp-marketplace <marketplace@gcp-partner.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:37:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Azureno x Redwood co-sell run of show — SI lead reassignment

All — final confirmation. We locked Option A (Tue 2027-05-18 10:00–11:00 PST). Calendar invite updated and shared with all participants.

What I changed:
- Consolidated runbook attached (Azureno_CoSell_Runbook_v3.pdf) — includes roles, timeboxes, slide deck link, and a 15m replacement brief for the SI lead.
- Calendar invite attached (calendar-invite-azureno.ics) and updated event description with breakout links.
- Playback recording will be uploaded to the shared Drive after the session (playback-recording.mp4 placeholder).

Who is presenting: Vanessa (AWS demo + positioning), Rishi (GCP marketplace technical breakout), Nico (customer context and business commentary), Marissa (intro and moderator).

Connor — I added your checklist items under "Ops" and linked the HubSpot deal (DBL-2027-0741). Please review the runbook and ping me if anything needs to be adjusted before tomorrow morning's dry run (08:30 PST).

Thanks everyone — see you tomorrow.

Attachments: Azureno_CoSell_Runbook_v3.pdf, calendar-invite-azureno.ics
